results.title: WSP completes acquisition of GCM Corpo
results.description: MONTREAL, Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- WSP Global Inc. (TSX: WSP) ("WSP"), one of the world’s leading engineering, science and infrastructure solutions firms, has completed its previously announced acquisition of GCM Corpo Inc. ("GCM Corpo"), a Canadian provider of engineering consulting and specialist services for the energy and industrial sectors. GCM Corpo brings approximately 600 professionals based in Québec, Western Canada and Atlantic Canada.

results.title: Higher gas, grocery prices keep inflation elevated at 3.1% despite relief elsewhere
results.description: OTTAWA - Canada's inflation rate held steady in October as higher prices for gas, groceries and clothes were partly offset by cheaper cellphone plans and slower rent price growth, Statistics Canada said Monday.
